title: SELEX Buffer Prep.
body:
### 1. **Nucleosome Dilution buff: TE buffer \+ 1mM TCEP \+ cocktail Tablet \+ 2mM MgCl2**

500 mL

| TE Buffer (100X) | 5 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| 100 mM TCEP | 5 mL |
| MgCl2 (1 M) | 1 mL |
| EDTA-free protease inhibitor | 10 tablets |

100 mM TCEP ⇒ 0.29 g in 10 mL water

### 2. **Biotin Elution Buffer**
400 mL

| 1X TCAPT Block | 200 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| Biotin | 0.98 g |
| Imidazole | 1.36 g |
| 10 M NaOH | 240 uL |

Make up the volume to 200 mL. DO NOT filter and aliquot 25 uL per well to 12 plates (needs \~120 mL buffer).
experiments: 1. **Nucleosome Dilution buff: TE buffer \+ 1mM TCEP \+ cocktail Tablet \+ 2mM MgCl2**
